turns.text: What are our margins by product?

Yes: cogs is the total cost of each sale in USD, every row is a normal sale, and group X is the product group. Compare each product with the group's overall margin each year and flag anything 5 points or more away from it. Separately, mark the products with more than $50k revenue in a year; those are the ones big enough to look at in detail.

csvChecks.ask: results.csv with columns year,group,product,revenue,cogs,margin,group_margin,deviation_bps,outlier,detail_needed: one row per product and year whose margin you could work out, margin and group_margin as fractions (0.25, not 25%), deviation_bps as the product's margin minus the group's in basis points, outlier and detail_needed as true or false
